ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level distribution displays a ratio of approximately 65:35 low-intensity (dark) to high-intensity (light) pixels across the visible ventral fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white fields are mapped to the distal lobes. The right lobe (viewer's perspective) contains a large white contiguous area beginning at the mid-lobe and extending to the tip, containing dark focal islands. The left lobe exhibits a smaller high-intensity white tip. The central region is a solid low-intensity dark field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression with an estimated internal angle of 45 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 12% of the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Trailing edge boundary displays low-frequency serrations with pixel-amplitude increases at the distal tips, where clusters of external growths (barnacles) disrupt the linear edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a concave curve towards the median notch, while the leading/outer edges show a convex trajectory towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of a cluster of 6-8 high-contrast circular white ring patterns (rosettes) located in the medial-lower quadrant of the right lobe. Dark, raised circular protrusions are concentrated at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple circular depigmentation scars on the right lobe surface and dense barnacle colonization localized on the trailing edge tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'islanding' pigmentation pattern where dark spots are isolated within the large white field of the right distal lobe.
